reconcile.note: Matthew Henry reads Paul's celibacy preference as suited to the church's contemporary distress, not a verdict that marriage itself is bad or Genesis wrong to bless it.

sides.snippet: It is not good that the man should be alone
sides.verseText: Yahweh God said, \"It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.\"

sides.snippet: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
sides.verseText: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
